newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council reaches agreement on bus rules revision.
newsitem.headline: Council reaches agreement on bus rules revision.

text.p: The Transport Council reached a political agreement on Thursday on a draft regulation governing non-resident bus operators offering services within a member state, a European Commission spokesman said.

The proposal lays down the conditions under which non-resident carriers may operate national road passenger transport services within a member state, a proposal which is intended to revise Regulation 2454/92.
The Commission draft, COM(95)729, also suggests the liberalisation of cabotage in certain regular services.
"There was a political agreement to open up certain specific, regular services," the spokesman said.

He added that these included the cross-border transport of school children, military personnel and workers on condition that operators met the social requirements of countries on whose territory they operated.
A draft Council statement said the file would be adopted as an "A" point, that is without discussion, at a subsequent Council.
